verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The wind-turbine icon, the original's focal image, has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail in a strip along the bottom. The green, red and blue triangles are cropped into odd fragments lined up in a row with the icon, which kills the layered corner composition. The oversized headline now dominates on its own, the diagonal lines float at random, and everything is crammed into the upper two-thirds with the decorative strip jammed against the bottom edge. A is marginally better because its headline sits closer to the canvas centre, while B's text block drifts left of centre and so lines up even less with the icon below it.
